files.description: Main EHI export documentation page for the $patient-everything operation (b(10) registered URL). Describes parameters, usage, and response format for exporting all patient data.
Markdown source of the $patient-everything EHI export documentation from the Medplum GitHub repository.
FHIR CapabilityStatement from the Medplum production server, listing all 146 supported resource types with their search parameters and operations.
OpenAPI 3.1 specification from Medplum with 737 schemas covering all FHIR resource types and data types. Provides complete field-level documentation.
ONC certification compliance page documenting how Medplum meets each ONC Health IT certification criterion, including b(10) EHI Export linking to $patient-everything.
Markdown source of the ONC compliance page from the Medplum GitHub repository.
Bulk FHIR API documentation page describing the alternative bulk data export mechanism using FHIR Bulk Data Access (Flat FHIR).
Markdown source of the Bulk FHIR API documentation from the Medplum GitHub repository.
TypeScript source code implementing the $patient-everything operation in the Medplum server, showing which resource types are queried and how patient compartment search works.
FHIR API overview page providing an introduction to Medplum's FHIR R4 REST API endpoints and capabilities.
FHIR resource types index page listing all 146 supported resource types with links to individual documentation pages.
Browser screenshot of the $patient-everything documentation page, providing visual evidence of the EHI export documentation as rendered.
Browser screenshot of the ONC certification compliance page, providing visual evidence of the b(10) EHI Export criterion documentation.
